name: link-provider
title: Link Provider
description: One rule for every link: a plain click on an in-app link is the host router's navigation in the same tab, a modified click stays the browser's, another origin opens a new tab. Set once at the app root; every VegaStack link reads it.

meta.whenToUse: Once, at the app root, with the router's push and the app's origin; AppLink or useOpenLink for a link or Open button of your own.
meta.whenNotToUse: A link that must always open a new tab inside an unanswered dialog (RecordList's ↗), or a download.
